description: The new table path does not validate that resolved positions name existing rows.
trigger: Pass a float32 table of shape (2, 64), 128-wide Q/K, and position=2 through RoPE.apply or an enabled Attention RoPE route.
expected_behavior: Reject a position outside the supplied table before launching a read.
actual_behavior: Shape validation accepts the width, but the first table index is 128, equal to the entire table's element count. No inspected wrapper or native guard checks row bounds. The three Attention routes forward caller-supplied overrides; no default workflow producing this invalid table was identified. At 234 the ordinary Mistral3 image path reaches this identity through floating ceiling overflow. A tall 1000x1541 image becomes 1008x1568: 112 patch rows, maximum position 12281 exceeds the 12100-row table. Wide 1541x1000 becomes 1568x1008: columns 110 and 111 alias next-row angles without exceeding the table. Source and scalar arithmetic only, no GPU execution.

verification.description: Calculated the first flattened index for position 2 in a two-row, 64-column table.
verification.limits: No GPU memory access or resulting fault was observed.
